note: Re-judged 2026-10-16: the unit moved verbatim to core compare_rfc8955_test.go, with only the family identifier renamed. RFC 8955 Section 4.2.1.1: "0: MUST be set to 0 on NLRI encoding and MUST be ignored during decoding". Wire op 0xf9 carries the reserved bit 0x08 and a leading AND. The positive requires the exact decoded []FlowMatch{{Op: FlowOpEqual, Value: 1<<56|7}}, so the reserved bit is ignored by core parseNumericComponent's 0x07 mask. The negative requires re-encoding to the exact op 0xb1, so reserved and leading AND are cleared by writeToAFI, and a missing end-of-list bit is refused.
